definitions.gloss: shy person; easily embarrassed person; someone who gets flustered easily
definitions.explanation: A person who is easily embarrassed or gets flustered, especially when praised or put in the spotlight. Often used affectionately to describe this trait.

examples.japanese: {照|て}れ{屋|や}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{褒|ほ}められる→褒める：01204_homeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I'm easily embarrassed, so my face turns red when I'm praised.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{照|て}れ{屋|や}で、⟦{人前|ひとまえ}→人前：19380_hitomae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ。
examples.english: My son is shy and not good at speaking in front of others.

notes:
{照|て}れ{屋|や} describes someone who gets embarrassed easily, especially when praised or put in the spotlight. It has a warm, endearing connotation — not a negative trait.

ETYMOLOGY:
From ⟦{照|て}れる→照れる：08152_tereru⟧ (to be embarrassed, to feel shy) + ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (suffix for a person with a characteristic trait).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {照|て}れ{屋|や}だ (to be the shy type)
- {照|て}れ{屋|や}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で〜 (because I'm easily embarrassed, ~)
- {照|て}れ{屋|や}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (a shy personality)

SIMILAR {屋|や}/{坊|ぼう} PERSONALITY WORDS:
- {恥|は}ずかし⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: shy person (general shyness)
- {寂|さび}し⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: person who gets lonely easily
- ⟦{甘|あま}えん{坊|ぼう}→甘えん坊：19928_amaenbou⟧: clingy/spoiled person
- {怒|おこ}りん{坊|ぼう}: hot-tempered person

USAGE:
Unlike {恥|は}ずかし⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ which implies broader social shyness, {照|て}れ{屋|や} specifically describes someone who gets flustered by praise or attention.
